summary: ObjectGenome validator/identity closure gap: familyId and variantKey are accepted by inspect() with no byte-length bound, but identityKey() forwards them to StableId, which rejects semantic parts over 512 bytes. A syntactically valid >512-byte lowercase semantic key can therefore produce inspect().ok=true yet fail canonical identity/defaultState. Primary should make identity-bearing semantic keys obey the StableId semantic-part byte limit and add regression coverage for both familyId and variantKey.
evidence: src/shared/Objects/ObjectGenome.luau: isSemanticKey checks syntax only; inspect uses it for familyId/variantKey; identityKey delegates identityParts to StableId.fromParts.
src/shared/Core/DeterminismContract.luau: stableId asserts each semantic part is <=512 bytes.
Docs/OBJECT_GENOME.md: familyId + familyVersion + variantKey + schemaVersion are the complete v1 stable identity input.
